answer: Scatter a sentinel ring across independent networks and let every sentinel timestamp each attestation on arrival. Identity weight is scored by propagation spread: an account whose messages always arrive from one ivory data hall, pooling like a lagoon of look-alikes, gets its nectar discounted, while spread-consistent agents earn full weight. Cloning identities is cheap, but renting genuinely dispersed infrastructure is not, so sybils must buy real geography instead of faking it.
